request: a simple block-building sandbox game with a 32x32 block world
thesis: A tiny Minecraft-like toy where every click visibly changes a small, fully legible 32x32 world, so building feels immediate and the whole world fits on one screen.
job: open the page and see a 32x32 world with some starting terrain
pick a block type from a palette (keys 1-9 or click)
place a block on a cell (left click / drag to paint)
remove a block (right click, shift-click or an erase tool)
see what is selected and what is under the cursor (hover highlight, coordinates)
build in more than one layer or height so it is 'block' building, not just a pixel paint
save and reload the world (localStorage, and survives refresh)

principles: a small verb set done well
tests: can a stranger build a house in 30 seconds without instructions

tricks: contextmenu suppressed so right click erases

principles: block faces read as cubes through shading
palette of 8 to 10 distinct, earthy materials
tricks: lighten top face, darken side faces
per-cell tiny noise so blocks feel textured
tests: blocks distinguishable at a glance, grid readable

principles: state in one array, render from state
tests: place then read state equals what drew

expectations: blocks have distinct looks (grass, dirt, stone, wood, leaves, sand, water, brick)

kinds.name: isometric 3D-look voxel stack
kinds.what: each of 32x32 columns has a height; drawn isometric with shaded cube faces

kinds.name: top-down tile grid
kinds.what: flat 2D grid, one block per cell, paint style

kinds.name: side-view layered slices
kinds.what: edit one layer at a time

descriptions: world = 32x32 columns each a stack of up to 8 blocks
start with gentle grass/dirt hills, a pond
behaviors: click top of column adds block on top

descriptions: each block type has a base colour; top face lighter, left side mid, right side dark
behaviors: selecting a type highlights hotbar slot

descriptions: hover highlights target column and shows x,y,height
behaviors: undo restores prior state stack up to 100 steps

anti_keywords.not: crafting, inventory, health, enemies, day/night, multiplayer
anti_keywords.instead: a 'simple' sandbox is only place, remove, pick block, undo, clear, save
canvas drawing with computed shading, no requests

anti_keywords.not: a flat paint-by-numbers grid with no sense of blocks
anti_keywords.instead: iso cube faces and stacking height

anti_keywords.not: context menu popping on right click

anti_keywords.instead: one array of heights/types, redraw from it

checks: world is exactly 32x32 and the page says so
click adds a block and the block count changes
selecting another palette block changes what gets placed
undo reverts the last action, clear empties, reload keeps world
works on phone width (touch placing, toolbar toggle for remove)
